title: When the Debt Sings
author: Edmund Voss
blurb: Noor Voss, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
